definitions.gloss: to kick away; to kick aside
definitions.explanation: To forcefully kick something, sending it flying away.

definitions.gloss: to kick over; to kick down
definitions.explanation: To knock something or someone down by kicking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|あ}き{缶|かん}→空き缶：23052_akikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす。
examples.english: To kick an empty can away.

examples.english: I walked while kicking stones out of my way.

examples.english: I kicked the box out of the way and passed through.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧ (to kick) + ⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧ (to make fly, to send away)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive) - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the object being kicked

ASPECT (ている):
{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばしている indicates the action is in progress or habitual.

REGISTER:
Neutral to casual. Often used in informal contexts.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{突|つ}き{飛|と}ばす→突き飛ばす：06135_tsukitobasu⟧: to push/shove away
- ⟦{殴|なぐ}り{飛|と}ばす→殴り飛ばす：29263_naguritobasu⟧: to punch and send flying
- ⟦{吹|ふ}き{飛|と}ばす→吹き飛ばす：04617_fukitobasu⟧: to blow away

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空|あ}き{缶|かん}→空き缶：23052_akikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick an empty can
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick a stone away
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{飛|と}ばす: to kick someone away (violent)
